dataTransforms.description:
List of data transform types, which will be applied after the data is
received but before saving it in the state.

Constraint: These types must extend {@link UiSdlDataTransform}.

format.description: Specifies the format options of the param kind

valueType.description:
Specifies how to transform the extracted value. The default is string, but depending on the use case
it may be useful to transform the value to a value type like numbers, arrays, etc.

id.description:
This field should usually not be set to anything else. Only change if
the configs are stored on a different {@link UiSdlSite}.

path.description:
The path from the root state of the `id` to the desired value.
Each level in the state should be traversed through a dot (.) delimiter.
Ex: 'c3arguments.arg1.field1'

action.description:
javascript action (expression) to perform on the state information.
References to the state path object can be made through 'statePathValue' variable.
The output of the action is expected to be stringifiable.

configType.description:
The type name of the config to access.

Note that this actually represents the field on `SDL.DefaultSite.configs` to access, so
for configs not fetched by {@link UiConfigPageContainer}, this should be set to `configType.fieldName`

includeBoxedType.description:
By default, if a config value is a boxed type, only its value will be returned when {@link UiConfigValueParam} is called.
If you want the type of Boxed this config value represents, set this boolean to true.
Ex: if `fieldA` is set to true in some `ConfigType`, {@link UiConfigValueParam} will return true with this boolean set to
false. If this boolean is set to true, it will return `{type: Boxed<boolean>, value: true}`.

disableActionOnNullishValue.description:
If true, #action is not run when the param resolves to `undefined` or `null`.
Otherwise, #action is always run.

title:
A {@link UiSdlDynamicValueSpecParam} that gets the value of a configuration. It assumes that the configuration + field
has been loaded into `SDL.DefaultSite` using {@link UiConfigPageContainer}.
name: UiConfigValueParam
